p: The LORD is my rock: He uses this diversity of names to show that as the wicked have many means to hurt, so God has many ways to help.
praised: For no one can obtain their request from God if they do not join his glory with their petition.
The sorrows of death compassed me: He speaks of the dangers and malice of his enemies from which God had delivered him.
Then the earth shook and trembled: A description of the wrath of God against his enemies, after he had heard his prayer.
fire out of his mouth devoured: He shows how horrible God's judgments will be to the wicked.
darkness was under his feet: Darkness signifies the wrath of God as the clear light signifies God's favour.
cherub: This is described at large in Ps 104:1-35.
secret place: As a king angry with the people, will not show himself to them.
his voice: Thunders, lightnings and hail.
his arrows: His lightening.
foundations of the world were discovered: That is, the deep bottoms were seen when the Red sea was divided.
waters: Out of many great dangers.
strong enemy: That is, Saul.
too strong for me: Therefore God sent me help.
he delivered me: The cause of God's deliverance is his favour and love for us.
righteousness: David was sure of his righteous cause and good behaviour toward Saul and his enemies and therefore was assured of God's favour and deliverance.
statutes from me: For all his dangers he exercised himself in the law of God.
iniquity: I neither gave place to their wicked temptations nor to my own desires.
merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful: Here he speaks of God according to our capacity, who shows mercy to his and punishes the wicked, as is also said in Le 26:21,24.
bring down high looks: When their sin is come to the full measure.
run through a troop: He attributes it to God that he both got the victory in the field and also destroyed the cities of his enemies.
word of the LORD is tried: No matter how great or many the dangers may be, yet God's promise must take effect.
way perfect: He gives good success to all my enterprises.
high places: As towers and forts, which he took out of the hands of God's enemies.
shield of thy salvation: To defend me from dangers.
gentleness hath made me great: He attributed the beginning, continuance and increase in well doing only to God's favour.
I have pursued mine enemies: David declares that he did nothing besides his calling, but was stirred up by God's Spirit to execute his judgments.
given me the necks of mine: You have given them to my hands to be slain.
cried: They who reject the cry of the afflicted, God will also reject them when they cry for help, for either pain or fear causes those hypocrites to cry.
heathen: Who dwell round about me.
known shall serve me: The kingdom of Christ is prefigured in David's kingdom, who by the preaching of his word brings all to his subjection.
submit themselves unto me: Or lie: signifying a subjection constrained and not voluntary.
fade away: Fear will cause them to be afraid and come forth from their secret holes and holds to seek pardon.
violent man: That is, Saul who out of malice persecuted him.
I give thanks unto thee: This prophecy belongs to the kingdom of Christ and calling of the Gentiles, as in Ro 15:9.
seed for evermore: This did not properly belong to Solomon, but to Jesus Christ.
